permitted.answer: Yes: Guest Services and the Environmental Officer coordinate the scattering of ashes on board.

documentedOrIndividualApproval.answer: Documented procedure, arranged individually with Guest Services on board.

advanceNotice.answer: Contact the Guest Services Desk once on board the ship.

leadTime.answer: Not published in the indexed official page content (read 2026-11-21).

contactDepartment.answer: Guest Services Desk on board; the Environmental Officer coordinates.

writtenApplication.answer: No form; Guest Services collects the preferred date and time, the number of attendees and a copy of the death certificate.

deathOrCremationCertificate.answer: The deceased's death certificate and certification that the cremation was done by a licensed facility.

containerRequirements.answer: Ashes kept in a sealed, leak-proof urn; the container must be wood, plastic, cardboard or non-lead ceramic. The indexed copy also says plastic urns are not permitted for dispersal.

biodegradableUrns.answer: To disperse the ashes with the urn, present a certificate that the urn is biodegradable.

scatterOrReleaseUrn.answer: Either: ashes may be dispersed, or released with the urn if it is certified biodegradable.

privateCeremony.answer: A Guest Services member escorts the family and guests are given a moment of privacy.

designatedArea.answer: May take place in a non-accessible area of the ship; guests may need to take stairs.

crewParticipation.answer: Guest Services escorts the family; the Environmental Officer coordinates.

chaplainCelebrant.answer: Not published in the indexed official page content (read 2026-11-21).

fees.answer: Not published in the indexed official page content (read 2026-11-21).

distanceOffshore.answer: Beyond twelve nautical miles from land and outside any special areas.

shipSelectsLocation.answer: Date and time set by environmental restrictions and the itinerary.

familyRequestLocation.answer: Not published in the indexed official page content (read 2026-11-21).

weatherItineraryLimits.answer: Date and time depend on environmental restrictions and the itinerary.

otherMemorialAssistance.answer: Commemorative flowers must be bought through the onboard Fun Shops, with no ribbon or non-biodegradable decorations. The urn may not be taken ashore in a port of call.

statusRationale: Version 1.6: the line's own policy page, read through the search engine's index of that official page (the page refuses automated requests), explicitly permits it, subject to its published requirements.

permitted.answer: Yes: a Memorial at Sea (scattering of ashes) service for human remains.

documentedOrIndividualApproval.answer: Documented FAQ procedure; time and location set by the ship's command.

advanceNotice.answer: Notify MSC by phone or through a travel agent before the cruise, then visit Guest Services on board to set the date, time and meeting place.

leadTime.answer: Not published in the indexed official page content (read 2026-11-21).

contactDepartment.answer: MSC (by phone) or your travel agent before sailing; Guest Services on board.

writtenApplication.answer: No form; give the ship, sail date, booking number, stateroom number, attendees' names, the deceased's name and urn details.

deathOrCremationCertificate.answer: MSC does not require a death certificate, but airport and port security may ask for one in transit.

containerRequirements.answer: Biodegradable urns only, carried in carry-on luggage; plastic ribbons, plastic flowers, plastic urns, balloons and other non-biodegradable items are prohibited.

biodegradableUrns.answer: Required, with a certificate from the urn manufacturer that it is fully biodegradable (stated on the international page; the indexed US page did not show the certificate line).

scatterOrReleaseUrn.answer: Not published in the indexed official page content (read 2026-11-21).

privateCeremony.answer: Groups of no more than 10 guests; a waiver may be required to access the location.

designatedArea.answer: Some locations may not be wheelchair accessible and may involve steep or spiral stairs; closed-toe shoes required.

crewParticipation.answer: Not published in the indexed official page content (read 2026-11-21).

chaplainCelebrant.answer: Not published in the indexed official page content (read 2026-11-21).

distanceOffshore.answer: At least 12 nautical miles from the coast.

shipSelectsLocation.answer: Yes: timing set by the ship's command based on weather and safety.

familyRequestLocation.answer: Not published in the indexed official page content (read 2026-11-21).

weatherItineraryLimits.answer: Only on cruises of 6 nights or longer with at least one sea day; timing depends on weather and safety.

gpsCoordinates.answer: Yes: the certificate shows the coordinates and time.

certificateConfirmation.answer: A certificate signed by the Navigation Officer or Captain, as a memento.

differsByVesselItinerary.answer: Depends on cruise length and sea days; regional pages differ slightly in wording.

otherMemorialAssistance.answer: MSC does not require EPA documentation; guests must follow the laws of places they pass through on the way to the port.

permitted.answer: Yes, human ashes, under the Memorial at Sea service.

documentedOrIndividualApproval.answer: Documented; time and location approved by the ship's Command.

advanceNotice.answer: Yes; notify MSC directly or through a travel agent before the cruise, then confirm time and place with Guest Services on board.

contactDepartment.answer: MSC (directly or via travel agent) before sailing; Guest Services on board.

writtenApplication.answer: Notification with ship, sail date, booking and cabin numbers, attendees, name of the deceased and urn details; no form named.

deathOrCremationCertificate.answer: Not required by MSC; airport or port security may ask for a death certificate.

containerRequirements.answer: Biodegradable urn only, carried in hand luggage, with the manufacturer's certificate that it is fully biodegradable; non-biodegradable items (plastic ribbons, flowers, balloons) prohibited.

privateCeremony.answer: Group limited to no more than 10 guests (see conflicts on which regional pages say this).

designatedArea.answer: Some locations may not be wheelchair accessible; closed-toe shoes required.

distanceOffshore.answer: International waters, at least 12 nautical miles from the coast.

shipSelectsLocation.answer: Yes; time and location approved by the ship's Command.

weatherItineraryLimits.answer: Only on cruises of 6 nights or longer with at least one sea day.

gpsCoordinates.answer: Yes; the certificate shows the coordinates and time.

certificateConfirmation.answer: Certificate signed by the Navigation Officer or Captain, as a keepsake.

differsByVesselItinerary.answer: Depends on cruise length (6+ nights, a sea day); regional FAQ pages differ slightly in wording.

name: Virgin Voyages
statusRationale: Virgin Voyages' Onboard Policies FAQ, read directly on 2026-11-21, answers "Yes" and sets out a Celebration of Life request form at least 14 days before sailing, with approval confirmed with port authorities and the ship.

permitted.answer: Yes, as a Celebration of Life on board.

documentedOrIndividualApproval.answer: Individual approval: Virgin works "with local port authorities and our shipboard teams to confirm everything is approved".

leadTime.answer: Complete the request form at least 14 days before the sail date.

writtenApplication.answer: Yes: the Celebration of Life Request Form (ship, sail date, party size, Certificate of Biodegradability).

deathOrCremationCertificate.answer: Not published on the official page (read 2026-11-21).

containerRequirements.answer: A Certificate of Biodegradability for the container to be used.

scatterOrReleaseUrn.answer: Not published on the official page (read 2026-11-21).

privateCeremony.answer: Party size is asked on the form; no limit published.

designatedArea.answer: Not published on the official page (read 2026-11-21).

crewParticipation.answer: Not published on the official page (read 2026-11-21).

chaplainCelebrant.answer: Not published on the official page (read 2026-11-21).

fees.answer: Not published on the official page (read 2026-11-21).

distanceOffshore.answer: Not published on the official page (read 2026-11-21).

shipSelectsLocation.answer: Not published on the official page (read 2026-11-21).

familyRequestLocation.answer: Not published on the official page (read 2026-11-21).

weatherItineraryLimits.answer: Not published on the official page (read 2026-11-21).

gpsCoordinates.answer: Not published on the official page (read 2026-11-21).

certificateConfirmation.answer: Virgin follows up before the voyage to confirm approval; no certificate afterward is mentioned.

differsByVesselItinerary.answer: Approval depends on local port authorities, so it can differ by itinerary.

petAshes.answer: Not published on the official page (read 2026-11-21).

otherMemorialAssistance.answer: Virgin does not offer single-use items such as balloons or individual flower arrangements on board (Onboard Celebrations FAQ).
